highlights: Your languages: names you type in Chinese, Japanese or Korean (Parts, layers, folders, brush sets, files) draw with your system's fonts instead of "?"
Stencil: clean, sharp groove edges when you sculpt through a stencil, and detailed photos stay even on lighter meshes
Restart to update: on Linux the previous version now quits, and Discord stops showing SculptForge when you close it (thanks @ebarranco)
SpaceMouse: turning the cap slowly no longer zooms the view away (thanks @fenixpoints)
App icon: the outline cube is back, and a fix for garbled small icon sizes on macOS (thanks @tristratos, #156)
